Do NOT use when the target is something other than a redis/rabbitmq broker (a hypervisor, storage appliance, backup product, container-orchestration cluster, database server, monitoring stack, or OT/industrial equipment) — route those to the appropriate other AIops-tools skill. Managed cloud queue services and other broker products are out of scope. Governed broker operations with a built-in governance harness (audit, policy, token budget, undo, risk-tiers).
